title: Decipher-MR
paper_title: Decipher-MR: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for 3D MRI Representations
core_mech: Decipher-MR 明确采用 8³ patch 的 3D ViT-Base、DINOv2/iBOT 视觉预训练、PubMedBERT MLM，再做器官感知的 MRI-report CLIP 对齐。
core_mech_en: 3D MRI vision–language foundation model combining an 8³-patch 3D ViT-Base (pretrained via 3D DINOv2/iBOT) with PubMedBERT MLM and organ-aware MRI–report CLIP alignment.
input_desc: 单个 3D MRI series 与同 study 的器官级报告文本
input_en: 3D MRI series volume + paired study-level organ-parsed radiology report text
output_desc: 512 维共享 MRI—文本 embedding、冻结视觉特征及轻量下游 decoder 输出
output_en: 512-D shared 3D MRI–text embedding and frozen 3D visual features for lightweight downstream decoders

source.title: Decipher-MR
notes: The paper's Code availability section names DINOv2, Hugging Face BERT training and OpenCLIP components, and states pretrained Decipher-MR weights may not be shared. No complete release is verified here; those frameworks are not a Decipher-MR release. Methods and supplementary details remain necessary for a paper-based implementation.

gaps: No complete public Decipher-MR release was verified. The named DINOv2/BERT/OpenCLIP components are not themselves Decipher-MR, and the paper states pretrained weights may not be shared.
